Theorem 1 (Chapter 136)

Subject: topological groups | ID: 43334

Step 2. By the free spectral theorem, we decompose \(Q_{01360012} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the free spectral family.

Step 3. By the orthogonal spectral theorem, we decompose \(P_{01360013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the orthogonal spectral family.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through perturbative approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
